fix: and one may grasp the magnitude of that change from what follows. [...]
reason: Excerptor’s note (ζήτει ἐν τῷ περὶ στρατηγίας) shows the promised illustration is not transmitted; the break must be marked.

fix: they came to think that rulers ought to have clothing distinct from that of their subjects
reason: Kings are subject of ὑπέλαβον; τῶν ὑποταττομένων is genitive of comparison. ‘Their rulers’ wrongly makes the people the thinkers.

fix: [...] and thirty years later; from that time on it was continually being refined
reason: ἔτεσιν ὕστερον is a point in time, not a duration; lacuna may hide part of the numeral. Corrupt text, translator should confirm.

fix: before reaching the age of forty-six
reason: ἀπὸ γενεᾶς means from birth, so the limit is age forty-six, not forty-six years after coming of age.
Polybius’s drachma equals the denarius (ten asses); the gloss ‘(asses)’ gives a false equivalence.

fix: place the market-place, quartermaster’s office, and headquarters between the two legions
reason: A lone consul’s camp holds two στρατόπεδα, meaning legions; the praetorium stands between them, not between separate camps.

fix: the duty falls to each maniple only every third day
reason: παρὰ τετάρτην ἡμέραν counts inclusively; three maniples rotating per tribune means each serves every third day.

fix: and most of those condemned are killed on the spot inside the camp itself
reason: τοὺς μὲν πλείστους refers to the condemned, contrasted with those who escape; ‘them’ grammatically points to the attackers.
